name: Non-Baked Models
aliases: Learning separate scene features from MLP parameters
definition: Models including innovations like learning separate scene features from MLP parameters via hybrid representations, enabling smaller MLPs for improved training and inference speed at the cost of increased memory.
summary: Non-Baked Models learn separate scene features from MLP parameters to reduce network size and speed up training and inference, differing from baked models by retaining differentiability during optimization.
